completion_scope: Four variant evaluations and GPT56 Fully reference; excludes Fully CS and does not certify API replay.

cold_statistics.aggregation: Per-run macro metrics, then mean and SD across three independent runs; no prediction pooling.

partially.stage1: Primary Partially tuple-extraction comparison, evaluated after its own dynamic name normalization.
partially.stage2: Additional matching to the 27 Gold leaderboard triples; tuple metrics are post-alignment diagnostics, not the primary Partially tuple comparison or the same naming scope as Fully.

cold_start.stage1: Dynamic open-vocabulary naming diagnostics; all three name sets started empty.
cold_start.stage2: Post-leaderboard-alignment tuple diagnostics; ColdStart primary results are the stage-2 leaderboard metrics across the three paper orders.

request_accounting.attempts: Physical HTTP attempts, including original failures and authorized retries.
request_accounting.successful_responses: Accepted physical responses; a parent retry pointer is not another response.
request_accounting.failed_or_unknown: Historical physical failures or uncertain attempts; retained after recovery.
request_accounting.logical_completed: Completed official request positions; replay is not another position.
request_accounting.authorized_additional_attempts: Explicitly authorized additional physical attempts, separate from automatic retries.
